Step into comfort.

KELZA SOFT is a factory-direct brand making premium gents sandals and supplying them straight to the trade. Our model is wholesale only — for dealers and retailers; single pairs are not sold at retail.

Every pair is made from premium rexine with a soft cushioned footbed, an adjustable buckle for a secure fit, and a durable, lightweight build made for daily wear. Before any pair leaves the factory, it is checked by hand — sole, stitching, rexine and comfort.

We work from Taragarh, Shahdara Town, Lahore, and dispatch wholesale orders across Pakistan. No middleman — honest wholesale rates, fresh stock and consistent quality.

  • Premium rexine material
  • Adjustable buckle for a secure fit
  • Soft cushioned footbed
  • Durable and lightweight

Size Guide

KELZA SOFT slippers are made in standard gents sizes. Exact sizes available for each article are confirmed on WhatsApp when you order — message us with the sizes you need and we will confirm availability.

How to measure

  • Stand on a sheet of paper and trace around the foot.
  • Measure the longest distance from heel to toe in centimetres.
  • Match the measurement to your usual gents size; if you are between sizes, choose the larger one.

Sizes may vary slightly by article. Always confirm sizes on WhatsApp before payment.

Care Instructions

  • Cleaning: wipe rexine with a soft, slightly damp cloth. Never use petrol, thinner, bleach or harsh detergents.
  • Drying: dry naturally in the shade. Never dry in direct sunlight or near a heater — heat stiffens rexine and causes cracks.
  • Storage: keep pairs in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight. Do not stack heavy boxes on displayed pairs.
  • Buckle: wipe the metal buckle dry if it gets wet; pull gently to set the fit — never force it.

Share these tips with your customers — cared-for slippers bring customers back for the next pair.
